desc: Heat noun. 2 mana, 1.0 power. 35% chance to set the target On Fire; further fire deepens the burn rather than extending it.
Cold noun. 2 mana, 0.9 power. 40% chance to Chill the target: -40% speed.
Lightning noun. 2 mana, 0.85 power. 30% chance to Jolt the target: 1.2 lightning damage each time its action bar fills, for 20 seconds.
Water noun. 2 mana, 0.8 power. 50% chance to make the target Wet: cold, lightning and poison resistance drop, heat resistance rises.
Earth noun. 3 mana, 1.15 power. 30% chance to inflict Shardbound: the target takes 0.8 piercing damage whenever it attacks or is struck in melee, for 30 seconds.
Wind noun. 2 mana, 0.85 power. 25% chance to Buffet the target: each point gives a 12% chance that a technique ends Off Balance instead of at its declared position.

Poison noun. 2 mana, 0.7 power. 50% chance to Seed the target. Seeded does nothing on landing; it grows 0.15 per second (each hit prunes 0.5, water damage feeds it 1), becomes Rootbound at 6, and records every other condition that lands. Rootbound spreads a quarter of that record to the other enemies every 3 seconds. Heat damage removes it.

Piercing noun. 2 mana, 0.9 power. 35% chance to Magnetize the target: each point ignores 10% of its dodge and gives piercing attacks +5% crit chance against it, lightning cannot miss it, and its dodge is also reduced by 3%.
Poison noun. 2 mana, 0.7 power. 60% chance to Poison the target: poison damage over time and -20% stamina regeneration. Only a stronger dose deepens it.
Acid noun. 2 mana, 0.7 power. Always Corrodes the target: -12% armor per point, stacking to 6.
Light noun. 3 mana, 0.9 power. 30% chance to Dazzle the target: 8% miss chance and -5% dodge; repeat hits extend the duration.
Dark noun. 3 mana, 1.0 power. 15% chance to Taint the target: every resistance drops, light and dark resistance most; at 5 stacks it escalates to Corrupted.
Untyped noun. 2 mana, 1.0 power. No element and no condition: no resistance reduces it and no weakness increases it.
Arcane noun. 3 mana, 0.9 power. 50% chance to inflict Unravelling: lowers arcane resistance; at 3 stacks it escalates to Manaburn.
Verb, slashing delivery. 2 mana. Damage x0.8; the noun’s condition applies at 2.2x the usual rate. Spoken with no noun: 0.55 slashing power, 40% chance to Bleed.
Verb, bludgeoning delivery. 2 mana. Damage x1.3; the noun’s condition applies at 0.45x the usual rate. Spoken with no noun: 0.7 bludgeoning power, 40% chance to Concuss.
Verb, piercing delivery. 1 mana. Damage x0.95, ignores 35% of armor; the noun’s condition applies at 0.6x the usual rate. Spoken with no noun: 0.5 piercing power, 40% chance to Puncture.
Verb. 1 mana. Cooldown x0.75, damage x0.9. Spoken with no noun: 0.4 power.
Verb. 2 mana. Damage x0.85; 50% of the main target’s raw damage spills onto one random flanker. Enough accumulated spill (1.5 raw) makes the spell hit every enemy. Spoken with no noun: 0.4 power.
Verb. 2 mana. Damage x1.35, cooldown x1.3. Spoken with no noun: 0.6 power.
Verb. 2 mana. Damage x0.6; the noun’s condition lasts twice as long. Spoken with no noun: 0.3 power.
Verb. 2 mana. Always lands on the speaker: +15% resistance to the noun’s element for 30 seconds. Spoken with no noun: +3 armor instead. Leading words lengthen it, trailing words thicken it.
Verb. 3 mana. Heals for 1.0 spell power. Lands on the speaker unless another target is spoken; addressed at an enemy, it heals the enemy.

Verb. 3 mana, cooldown x1.2. Makes the spell a counterspell: it is never cast on its own, and fires when an enemy casts. Efficiency: 20%, +7.5% per extra undo tier, +5% per arcane tier, plus a match bonus for each element tier the enemy spell also uses. The enemy spell loses that share of its effect (all of it at 100% or more), and its caster takes manaburn of efficiency x1.0 spell power. Efficiency can exceed 100%.
Adverb. 1 mana, spell mana x1.2. Damage x1.4, cooldown x1.5. Leading: conditions last 2x as long at full rate. Trailing: 3x as long at a third of the rate.
Adverb. 1 mana. Damage x0.75, cooldown x0.65. Leading: conditions run in a quarter of the time at 3x rate. Trailing: half the time at 2x rate.

Adverb. 1 mana, spell mana x0.85. Damage x0.5 per tier; condition intensity is unchanged. Leading: -5% crit chance. Trailing: -20% crit damage. Use it to apply a condition, to an enemy or to yourself, at low cost.
Adverb. 2 mana, spell mana x1.4. Leading: +7% crit chance per tier. Trailing: +25% crit damage per tier.
Adverb. 2 mana, spell mana x1.3. Condition intensity x1.6. Trailing: condition duration x0.6 as well.
Adverb. 1 mana, spell mana x0.9. Condition intensity x0.6, never below 15% of the condition’s base. Trailing: condition duration x1.6 as well.
Adverb. 2 mana, spell mana x1.8. Leading: two separate landings, each rolling its own crit and conditions. Trailing: one landing at double weight.
Conjunction. 1 mana. The next clause takes the better armor penetration of the two clauses and deals x1.3 damage, but only if the previous strike landed on that target.
Conjunction. 2 mana. Fuses the next clause into the previous blow: its weight is added at 85%, the blow deals whichever of the two damage types the target resists less, and both conditions apply.
Conjunction. 2 mana. The next clause does not strike; its condition replaces the previous blow’s condition. A word with no condition removes the blow’s condition instead.
Conjunction. 1 mana. The linked clauses become alternatives: one is rolled per cast, and each linked clause pays half its mana.
Conjunction. 1 mana. The next clause does not strike; its noun names a condition, and the previous blow fires only while the target has that condition or one it escalates into.

Conjunction. 1 mana. A next clause with a noun and no verb joins the previous clause instead of acting: an undo also matches the noun’s element, a blow also applies the noun’s condition, a ward also adds resistance to the noun’s element at 75% (armor with no element), a mend also heals the noun’s power at 75%. A clause with its own verb acts on its own.
Target word: the front enemy. 0 mana. The default when no target is spoken.
Target word: every enemy. 2 mana, and the spell’s mana x1.5. Each enemy takes 50% power.
Target word: the speaker. 0 mana. Damage and conditions land on you.
